output.summary: Oakland Enrolls, the charter application platform, will share student-level data with the district so the district can study enrollment patterns and write reports. output.headline: Directs the Board Secretary to cast the district's ballot in the 2020 CSBA Delegate Assembly election
output.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution that tells its Secretary how to cast the district's ballot for up to three candidates in the California School Boards Association (CSBA) 2020 Delegate Assembly election for Sub-Region 7-B (Alameda County).
